description:
Melt-source position test, step 2 (5 Nov 2026): where do hollows sit within peak and floor terrain?
Reads cache/H{150,250,400}_000_354.npz from positions_build.py. Each hollow (or hollow field, counted once at its centroid)
is compared with the completeness-weighted area of the same terrain class.
Two nulls: (i) pooled area -- density ratio DR = (n_in/A_in)/(n_out/A_out) summed over craters; (ii) crater-matched --
each crater's hollows are spread over that crater's own weighted-area distribution (expected E_in = sum_c n_c A_in,c/A_c),
giving the stratified ratio SDR = (O_in/E_in)/(O_out/E_out), which removes between-crater differences.
95% intervals: 2,000 bootstrap resamples of craters (seed 1). Position uncertainty: 25 jittered hollow positions
(0.5 km per axis) from the build step. Writes positions_record.json, hollow_positions.csv and fig_positions.png.

bands.peak_base: distance to nearest floor-class cell <= 2 km
bands.q: completeness-weighted height quantile within the crater's peak terrain
bands.floor_margin: min(distance to wall-class, to peak-class cell) <= 3 km

ratio_definitions.OE_in: observed / crater-matched expected count in band

signed_peak_base.note: craters with peak terrain; negative = floor cells (distance to nearest peak cell), positive = peak cells (distance to nearest floor cell); crater-matched null over peak+floor

floor_radius_stratified.note: crater-matched null within crater x radial bins (0-0.2, 0.2-0.4, 0.4-0.6, 0.6-0.8 R)

g9_additions.note: floor hollows/fields vs completeness-weighted floor area; d_marg_R = min(distance to wall-class, to peak-class cell) / host radius; radius_stratified = crater-matched null within crater x radial bins (RB)

g11_additions.note: eta_b = (z - z_base)/(z_peak95 - z_base), z_base = 5th percentile of the crater's valid peak-cell elevations; bands as for eta (< 1/3 low, >= 2/3 high; eta_b < 0 counts as low). Near-wall / near-peak: floor cells and floor hollows/fields with d_wall/R or d_peak/R below the threshold vs the rest of the floor; floor in craters without wall (peak) cells has infinite distance and drops out of that test, as in g9.
